content:
Ravi: re: profile shim ideawe should support tenant-locking of bitwidths (e.g., enterprise A only int8) w/o forcing model owners to reauthor profiles.
Nia: agree. two primitives: shim mapping (name->runtime-profile) and artifact conversion (materialize new quant files).
Pedro: mapping is lowest-effort but risky: runtime kernel substitution may change output distribution. need traceable signal.
Yuna: propose request tracing header: X-precision-resolved: {orig_profile, effective_profile}. runtime logs kernel_id + quant_fingerprint.
Ravi: good. also add a model metadata field quant_fingerprint (string hash of scale/zero/params) so alias decisions can be conservative.
Nia: on op modes: default behavior = allow mapping only in dev/staging. Dedicated/private can enable artifact-conversion-on-deploy. Hosted must opt-in per-tenant.
Pedro: how to detect regressions? add deg_score in our eval pipeline and correlate by model_id + resolved_profile. if deg_score delta > threshold, auto-pause shim.
Yuna: ops-bot: runbook snippet:
```
- monitor: deg_score, hallucination-rate, token-err-rate
- action: if deg_score + latency regress > thresh -> disable mapping for model, notify owner, kick shadow replay
- escalation: SevOps if customer SLA impacted
```
Ravi: onboarding lint: warn when uploaded profile has no fingerprint or ambiguous name collisions. require owner ack to allow mapping.
Nia: console: surface "effective precision" on model page and a link to latest shadow-compare report. API to fetch effective_profile for model_id.
Pedro: perf: if mapping downgrades to int8, warmup kv-cache w/ small canary (3-5 prompts) so cold-latency isn't mis-attributed.
Yuna: security/privacy: sampling for telemetry must respect tenant retention settings and PII rules. add tenant-level telemetry toggle.
Ravi: rollback story: mapping can be flipped off at model-level, and conversion artifacts can be used as fallback. ops playbook should include fast flip and traffic split.
Nia: implement plan: 1) schema for shim mapping (Yuna) 2) request-header + runtime logging (Pedro) 3) onboarding linter + console UX (Nia) 4) eval join for deg_score per resolved profile (Ravi).
ops-bot: ticket created: ML-quant-shim-923 assigned to eng-ml.
Pedro: I'll sketch the header logging and kernel_id tag this week.
Yuna: will draft mapping schema and example config. sample config:
```
precision_shim:
  default: pass-through
  tenants:
    corp-x: mapping
  mapping:
    "vendor/bert-v1/fp8-medium": "redwood/int8/bert-medium-v3"
```
Ravi: keep mappings explicit and avoid wildcarding for now. good discussion. sync Friday for design review. :thumbsup:
